items.information: # ENGLISH **Mandatory Competition tutorial** All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers. Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete. **Special Competition Format** This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously. Each competitor will have a 35-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose. Each competitor in blindfolded events will have a 3-hour cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose. # ČESKY **Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící** Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky. Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit. **Speciální formát soutěže** Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň. Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 35 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru. Každý soutěžící v disciplínách poslepu má k dispozici 3 hodiny, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.name: Bolivia Nationals 2026
items.information: 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing. Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial. La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia! 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special. We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship. Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MDQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c0d143d39819bad425907a01d1201cca236592fa/BN26%20-%20WCA%20-%20%20Banner.png)

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Decidimos continuar o formato do ano passado, com um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** We are really excited to announce a new Capivara! We have decided to keep last year's format, with one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: Master Cube HCMC 2026 will be organized on December 12th and 13th 2026 with 150 competitors limit at AEON HALL (3rd floor AEON MALL TAN PHU CELADON). From January 2nd, 2027, WCA's competitions will switch to using a 4-pad mode timer instead of 2-pad as before. Therefore, this is the last WCA competition in Ho Chi Minh City using a timer in 2-pad mode. And this competition will be held by cubingHCM team. items.name: Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026

venue.name: Lippo Icon Gajah Mada
venue.address: Jl. Gajah Mada No.19-26, RT.2/RW.1, Petojo Utara, Kecamatan Gambir, Kota Jakarta Pusat, Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta 10130

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMDUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb89206b5263dbd95b0c2c4f82523a97b1aff0d5/home%20wca%20ic%2026.png) # Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum. Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut. **Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.** **Catatan Penting:** Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama) Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: * **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori * **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan * **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3 Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung. Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag. Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event. Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran. ----------------------- # Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public. All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition. All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified. **On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.** **Important Notes:** There are competitor limits for the following events: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors) There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition: * **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event * **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality * **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event. All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag. Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event. Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3OTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--279a016a5545862ad7b5d27844f6185ca48fc68a/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr die ersten Austrian Nationals ankündigen zu dürfen! Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Die Championship wird im Großen Saal und Turnsaal der Pfarre Akkonplatz stattfinden. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the first ever Austrian Nationals! The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Cuboss Open - Uppsala 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1MDYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba01789f78e1cb5afc0fff3b42388bb78a8bf771/cuboss-open-2026-logo.png) Varmt välkomna till Cuboss Open 2026! Detta blir en väldigt speciell tävling, där WCA-grenarna blandas med en mängd olika specialgrenar. Dessutom kommer det ske väldigt mycket roliga grejer i lokalen. Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Det kommer filmas och tas bilder i tävlingslokalen under tävlingens gång. Ta kontakt med arrangörsteamet så snart som möjligt om du inte vill synas i dessa. -- Welcome to Cuboss Open 2026! This will be a very special competition, where the WCA events are mixed with a variety of special events. In addition, there will be a lot of other fun happenings at the venue. Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B:** There will be filming and photography in the competition venue during the competition. Please contact the organizing team as soon as possible if you do not want to be seen in these. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Salonica Autumn Open 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b39acc8afc2f42f3a6da807026b51e138f0abec/image.png) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει! Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back! On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments. Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process. Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026
items.information: **Welcome to Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026!** **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc0MTMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a458e6deff7a3097077605b82ba6ed6cb6f8495/60d4732d-5344-4eab-a473-19f2d1891969.png) **German** Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber, wir freuen uns, euch zum 2. Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende 2026 am 24. und 25. Oktober 2026 einzuladen. Nach zwei erfolgreichen Ausgaben im Herbst 2025 und Frühjahr 2026 heißen wir euch erneut in Wuppertal zu einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerbswochenende willkommen. Teilnehmende aller Erfahrungsstufen sind herzlich eingeladen – ganz gleich, ob es eure erste Competition ist oder ihr bereits an vielen Wettbewerben teilgenommen habt. Wir freuen uns auf ein Wochenende mit offiziellen Solves, neuen persönlichen Bestzeiten und dem Austausch mit der Community. Bitte lest vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch. Wir hoffen, euch in Wuppertal zu sehen! **English** Dear cubers, We are excited to invite you to the 2nd Wuppertal Cubing Weekend 2026 on October 24–25, 2026. Following two successful editions in autumn 2025 and spring 2026, we are once again delighted to welcome you to Wuppertal for an official WCA competition weekend. Participants of all experience levels are warmly invited to join—whether this is your very first competition or you have already attended many events. We look forward to a weekend of official solves, new personal bests, and connecting with the cubing community. Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering. We hope to see you in Wuppertal!

Durante estos 10 años, SpeedCube Baja Open ha sido escenario de récords, emoción y la unión de la comunidad cubera. Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing y Baja Cubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 Seja bem vindo ao **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Instruções de participação: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **02/10/2026**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * Todos os participantes devem ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para para o e-mail da organização (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 Welcome to **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Participation instructions: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/02/2026**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the organization (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun!

This is not only an opportunity to test your skills, compete with the strongest participants and spend time in a friendly atmosphere, but also to support Ukraine. Together we prove that every move matters, and unity makes us stronger. All relevant information regarding registration, schedule, rules, possible changes and other organizational issues will be published in the Telegram group of the event. Solve it quickly. Support Ukraine. Together to victory! 💙💛

items.name: Trondheim Høst 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - By registering, you agree to assist as a judge, runner, or in any other role requested by a delegate; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. items.name: Maltese Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--417935762bfb96f37d3a4122e860cb7a459231ec/91697.jpg) Welcome to Maltese Championship 2026, the fourth official WCA competition in Malta! Whether you’re competing for the first time or returning for another competition, we’re excited to welcome you to our growing speedcubing community. Competitors from all countries are warmly invited to take part. While prizes and national titles are reserved for Maltese competitors, every participant will compete on equal terms and receive official WCA results. Our aim is to make Maltese Championship 2026 our biggest and most welcoming competition yet, bringing together cubers of all ages and experience levels for a memorable day of competition and community. Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#76640-for-new-competitors). **Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026/register) section for details.** [T-shirts are available to order](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#78743-championship-t-shirt-competitors-supporters) for competitors and supporters by the 6th September 2026.

As inscrições devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, com pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição só será confirmada após a validação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizar gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e vídeos registrados durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. ⚠️ Atenção: No momento da inscrição, informe um telefone de contato no campo de observações. Caso pretenda levar um convidado, inclua também o nome completo dele no mesmo campo. Devido ao espaço limitado no local da competição, cada competidor poderá levar apenas 1 (um) convidado, mediante pagamento de uma taxa de R$ 10,00. --- **🇺🇸 English (EN-US)** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registration must be completed exclusively through the WCA website, with advance payment of the fee via PIX (Brazilian instant payment system). Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. By registering, you authorize AACM, the WCA, and their partners to use your image free of charge in photos and videos recorded during the event, including for commercial purposes. ⚠️ Attention: When registering, please provide a contact phone number in the comments/notes field. If you plan to bring a guest, also include their full name in the same field. Due to limited space at the competition venue, each competitor may bring only 1 (one) guest, subject to a R$ 10.00 (ten Brazilian reais) fee.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d276ee4a1432869c38d809b8802b47006f609e10/Megamente_2026.png) # Español Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden. **Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia. Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?** Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es... **qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.** #### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**. ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ # English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot. **Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition. But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?** Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is... **how far you can push your mind.** #### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1Njc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40a4223db9dd06f7297c00e40277715abf8db574/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών. Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **B μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way. This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season. Important: This competition **is Part B** of a two-competition series. Competitors may participate in ONLY one of the two competitions in this series. **Events (Part B):** * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento será necessário informar o CPF e nome tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it will be required to inform an ID number for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 175kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 175 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Road to Nats Maracay 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **40**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMaracayII2026#79335-) for you. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. items.information: **Important Information for Participants:** **Location:** The competition will take place at the Atrium of the Mall **Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of their puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID. ##### Spectators and Non-solving Participants will not be allowed within the solving area We look forward to seeing you at the competition at the biggest Mall in Thrissur! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. **On The Spot Registration** * On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition if 100 competitors do not complete online registration. * All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule * OTS Registrations are only available on day 2 of the competition * OTS Registration is only available from 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM * OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2, 4x4 and Pyraminx ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1NDI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0e973ee774a9ad061c2ea56f9485a93d113dd3e1/image.png)

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2Njg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be50ae158823f554eaf24566a8f1a7aa4c6d9eb2/IMG_4169.png)

items.information: **Bem-vindos ao segundo campeonato no Sudoeste do Paraná!** ​ 🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [Guia para competidores novatos](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing). ​ Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. Competidores participando pela primeira vez devem apresentar um documento oficial que contenha foto, nome completo, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. ​ Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes da competição. ​ Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral na primeira rodada). ​ Após o término do prazo das inscrições, serão aceitas inscrições no local do campeonato apenas na modalidade 3x3x3, no valor de R$ 35,00. O Competidor deverá chegar com 30 minutos de antecedência e a inscrição só será aceita caso ainda haja vagas. --- ​ **Welcome to the second competition in the Southwest of the state of Paraná!** ​ 🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, read this [Guide for newcomers](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing). ​ All competitors must present a valid photo ID at the check-in. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document containing a photo, full name, date of birth, and nationality. ​ Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. ​ There will be awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for female competitors and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will be based on the ranking of the first round). ​ After the registration period ends, registrations will be accepted at the competition venue only for the 3x3x3 event, for BRL 35.00. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes in advance and registration will only be accepted if there are still registration slots available. ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIzMzQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--50ba046bdd4bc45b71c5b6e35a6c12a4d2d8f75b/dv%20open.jpg)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk5MzkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8bc8fc88449269dc1ed771d007b06b274f956be3/2.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Road to Nats Valencia 2026 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **35 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsValencia2026#77218-nuevos-competidores-new-competitors) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, puede ver la pestaña de [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsValencia2025#61961-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) o contactar al equipo organizador. #### 📸 Aviso de Filmación Al asistir a **Road to Nats Valencia 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Road to Nats Valencia 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **35**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsValencia2025#61960-nuevos-competidores-new-competitors) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, you can check [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsValencia2025#61961-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) or contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Road to Nats Valencia 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20del%20torneo%20*Road%20to%20Nats%20Valencia%202026*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Antonio Sánchez: Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20del%20torneo%20*Road%20to%20Nats%20Valencia%202026*) rafaelmachele@gmail.com

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a8ab6aa393063e4885b78fe22730fbdb06d76ab9/Kewbz%20UKC26%20LOGO.jpg) ## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

venue.name: Langenstein Stockhalle
venue.details: Follow the signs to the venue

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4NDUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6547f5d596befc73699700f8fea7d96dde8f8efb/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Du wirst in einer Gruppe antreten und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Wenn du in einem dieser Events teilnimmst, MUSST du während der gesamten Dauer beider Gruppen anwesend sein (d.h. von 19:30 bis 21:10 Uhr), sonst darfst du nicht teilnehmen. Möchtest Du nur beim 3x3x3 (Tab "3x3x3 Dual Round" beachten) mitmachen, kannst Du natürlich vorher schon gehen. ###Bitte lies vor deiner Anmeldung unbedingt den Reiter „Special Format“. --- [*EN*] ###This competition will be run in two groups for the events 2x2x2, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and 3x3x3 Blindfolded. You will compete in one group and help out in the other group as a runner, judge, or scrambler. If you participate in one of these events, you MUST be present for the entire duration of both groups (i.e. from 19:30 to 21:10), otherwise you cannot participate. If you only want to compete in 3x3x3 (See tab "3x3x3 Dual Round"), then obviously you may leave earlier. ###Please make sure to read the tab "Special Format" carefully before registering.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg2MDQ4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f2b0d908f18e079874aebc1d845f74b2731566c4/cactusini%20cubini%20chico%20chico.png)](https://www.instagram.com/asa_speedcubing/) --- Bienvenidos a "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". El nombre del torneo rinde homenaje a la Pachamama, la Madre Tierra en la cosmovisión andina. Durante todo el mes de agosto, nuestra región lleva a cabo un rito ancestral para agradecer a la tierra por sus frutos mediante ofrendas tradicionales, como alimentos, bebidas y hojas de coca. **POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE** --- Welcome to "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". The tournament's name pays tribute to the Pachamama, the Mother Earth in the Andean worldview. Throughout August, our region holds an ancestral ritual to thank the earth for its harvest through traditional offerings, such as food, beverages, and coca leaves. **PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyODYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1e4894d78da01f540cf034021bf4d9bf981e69c8/nm2026.jpeg) ## 🇳🇴 (NB) Informasjon Velkommen til norgesmesterskapet i kubing 2026, denne gangen tilbake i Trondheim. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er hjertelig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇳🇴 (NN) Informasjon Velkomen til noregsmeisterskapen i kubing, som er tilbake i Trondheim i år. Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegongsdeltakarar Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png) **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.name: Eagle of the East Baku 2026
items.information: Cənubi Qafqazın ən böyük şəhəri olan, Azərbaycanın şərqində qartal kimi ucalan və Xəzərin sahilində yerləşən gözəl Bakımıza xoş gəlmisiniz! **Şərq Qartalı Bakı 2026 (Eagle of the East Baku 2026)** bütün kubsevərlər üçün açıq olan, dostluq və rəqabət ruhunu bir araya gətirən möhtəşəm bir Rubik kubu yarışıdır. Ənənəyə çevrilmiş bu yarışda 2026-cı ildə də həm yeni iştirakçıları, həm də təcrübəli speedcuber-ləri bir arada görməkdən böyük məmnunluq duyacağıq. Sürət, həyəcan və unudulmaz anlarla dolu bu yarışda sizi də aramızda görməyə şad olarıq! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** yarışı [Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası](https://aka.az/) tərəfindən təşkil olunur. Welcome once again to Baku - the largest city in the South Caucasus, proudly rising in the eagle-shaped eastern part of Azerbaijan and beautifully located on the shores of the Caspian Sea! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** is a friendly and exciting Rubik’s Cube competition open to everyone who wants to participate. Continuing the tradition with renewed energy, we are thrilled to bring cubers together once again in 2026 and hope to welcome many new and returning participants from near and far. Join us for a competition full of speed, fun, community spirit, and unforgettable moments! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** competition is organized by [Azerbaijan Cube Association](https://aka.az/).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgzNzQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--85d7f1c565dad12a0a3f3ad8a2e9946cf4745708/Anuncio_cuadrado.png) **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** Durante el evento se realizarán fotografías y grabaciones de video que podrán ser utilizadas por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión institucional. Al participar, aceptas el uso de tu imagen conforme a lo establecido en nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photographs and video recordings will take place during the event and may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotional, documentation, and outreach purposes. By attending, you consent to the use of your image in accordance with our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: # Deuxième Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! L’aventure continue ! Après une première compétition en 2025, nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir pour la **deuxième compétition officielle WCA en Côte d’Ivoire**, qui aura lieu le **samedi 4 juillet** ! Que vous ayez déjà participé à une compétition ou que vous découvriez tout juste le speedcubing, cette compétition est faite pour vous. Plusieurs épreuves officielles seront au programme : **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 à une main**, **Skewb** et **Pyraminx**. Vous pouvez participer à celles que vous souhaitez ! **Première compétition WCA ?** Aucun problème ! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** sera proposé pour vous expliquer le déroulement, les règles et l’arbitrage. Pensez simplement à apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Rejoignez-nous pour continuer à faire grandir la communauté du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire — venez résoudre, concourir et partager ce moment avec nous ! --- # Ivory Coast’s Second Official WCA Competition! The journey continues! After a first competition in 2025, we are excited to welcome you to the **second official WCA competition in Ivory Coast**, taking place on **Saturday, July 4th**! Whether you have already competed before or are just discovering speedcubing, this competition is for you. Several official events will be held: **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 One-Handed**, **Skewb**, and **Pyraminx**. Feel free to compete in any or all of them! **First WCA competition?** No worries! A **newcomer tutorial** will be available to guide you through the competition format, rules, and judging. Just remember to bring a valid **ID** for registration. Come and be part of the growing speedcubing community in Ivory Coast — solve, compete, and enjoy the experience together!

items.information: # Português • A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. • Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. • **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. • **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. • As inscrições custam R$ 25,00 (vinte e cinco reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). • Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 30,00 (trinta reais), caso haja vagas. • # English • Registration is open to any person, from any country. • To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. • **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. • **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. • Registration costs R$25.00 (twenty five Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). • On-site registrations will be accepted for R$30,00 (Thirty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

items.information: North Carolina and Southeast Cubing, Inc. would like to welcome everyone to Raleigh for **[Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)**! This Pride competition is to celebrate and support LGBTQ+ cubers and allies. Any person may register for this competition. **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71720-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. items.information: ## ABOUT THIS EVENT This competition will be the highest from ground level ever held in the World. Additional guests will be allowed on other floors of the Leonardo, however only those with spectator tickets will be allowed inside the cubing venue.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2026! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF for dere som gir oss beskjed om det. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members who inform us about their membership. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: **Αυτός ο διαγωνισμός απευθύνεται σε άτομα που συμμετέχουν για πρώτη φορά και σε λιγότερο έμπειρους διαγωνιζόμενους, αλλά όλοι είναι ευπρόσδεκτοι. Παρόλο που ο διαγωνισμός είναι ανοικτός σε όλους, μόνο οι διαγωνιζόμενοι που έχουν συμμετάσχει σε 3 ή λιγότερους διαγωνισμούς στο παρελθόν θα έχουν δικαίωμα για μετάλλια.** **This competition is targeted at first-time participants and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Even though the competition is open to everyone, only competitors who have participated in 3 or fewer competitions in the past will be eligible for medals.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyNDIyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a933401125a79a3d07562b86d1bb5f492a5862a/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 Β (14/6)** έρχεται για να φέρει το καλοκαίρι… στα πιο γρήγορα solves! 🌞🧊 Πρόκειται για έναν φιλικό και ανοιχτό διαγωνισμό speedcubing στην Αθήνα, σχεδιασμένο με έμφαση στους **αρχάριους**, αλλά χωρίς κανέναν περιορισμό συμμετοχής για όλους τους Cubers. Είτε κάνεις τα πρώτα σου βήματα είτε έχεις ήδη εμπειρία, μπορείς να δηλώσεις συμμετοχή και να ζήσεις την εμπειρία ενός επίσημου WCA διαγωνισμού μέσα σε ένα χαλαρό και υποστηρικτικό περιβάλλον. Η ιδιαιτερότητα του διαγωνισμού είναι ότι **τα podium θα είναι αφιερωμένα στους νέους cubers**. Ετσι, όσοι έχουν ολοκληρώσει έως και 3 επίσημους διαγωνισμούς μέχρι την εγγραφή τους θα διεκδικήσουν τις θέσεις των μεταλλίων. Με αυτό τον τρόπο, δίνεται η ευκαιρία στους αρχάριους να ξεχωρίσουν και να απολαύσουν τη χαρά της διάκρισης, ενώ όλοι οι υπόλοιποι συμμετέχοντες μπορούν να αγωνιστούν κανονικά και να απολαύσουν τη διοργάνωση. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Β μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **ΜΟΝΟ σε έναν από τους δύο**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 2x2 * 3x3 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **The WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 B (June 14th)** is coming to bring the summer vibes... to the fastest solves! 🌞🧊 This is a friendly and open speedcubing competition in Athens, designed with an emphasis on **beginners**, but without any participation restrictions for any cubers. Whether you are taking your first steps or already have experience, you can register and live the experience of an official WCA competition within a relaxed and supportive environment. The unique feature of this competition is that **the podiums will be dedicated to new cubers**. Specifically, only those who have completed up to 3 official competitions by the time of their registration will be eligible for medals. This gives beginners a chance to stand out and enjoy the thrill of winning, while all other participants can compete as usual and enjoy the event. Note: This competition is **Part B** of a two-competition series. You may participate in **ONLY one of the two**. Competition B events: * 2x2 * 3x3 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!** Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7. **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. ----- Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **NOTE:** The 6x6x6, 7x7x7 and Megaminx events **can not** be combined with the 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD events. This means that, for example, you **can not** enter both Megaminx and 3x3x3 BLD, but you can enter both Megaminx and 7x7x7. **NOTE:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1OTI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f0650ca58223b353bab20a452b3dca7389995219/CaminosCelaya.jpg) ***🎵"“Tú y las nubes me traen muy loco, Tú y las nubes me van a matar, Yo pa' arriba, volteo muy poco, Tú pa' abajo, no sabes mirar”..."🎶*** El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Celaya para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Celaya to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/
